title: Extended Pharmacy Supply for Established Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Members
content:
**Tailwise Autoship pharmacy supply — members' extended supply**

Extended supply for established members adds days to the planned supply days of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy shipment when its package count is re-set. The membership is read from the customer's Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus record, and the tenure from the enrollment date of the pharmacy Autoship.

| Rewards membership in status active | Pharmacy Autoship enrolled at least … days before the re-set | Days added to the planned supply days |
|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards VIP, Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 365 | 60 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 180 | 30 |
| Any other customer (Pals Rewards Member, no active membership, or a tier above without the tenure shown on its own line) | — | no days |

The tenure is the number of calendar days from the pharmacy Autoship's enrollment date to the day of the re-set.

## Both sides of each line (hypothetical customers)

| Membership in status active | Tenure on the day of the re-set | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 365 days | 60 |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 364 days | none |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 200 days | none: the VIP line needs 365 days, and the 180-day line is for Pals Rewards Insider only |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 180 days | 30 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 179 days | none |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 500 days | 30 |
| Pals Rewards Member | 900 days | none |
| Tailwise Plus membership not in status active | any | none |

A customer qualifies on one line only; days are never added from both.
